name: Discovery Gas Transmission Pipeline
researcher_notes: No existing GEM row (name, Ewing Bank, Larose searched; P0159 Bridgeline only starts at Larose). Operating line, so the in-service state is the concrete step. Sponsor is Discovery Gas Transmission LLC, owned by Discovery Producer Services (Williams 60 percent, DCP Midstream 40 percent per an Oil and Gas Journal report on the Keathley Canyon Connector from 2015; current ownership not rechecked). An Oil and Gas Journal article from the 1998 start-up describes a 105 mile 30 inch main line from Ewing Bank 873 to the Larose plant, ultimate capacity 900 MMcf per day, deepest 30 inch line in the Gulf then. The EIA August 2026 release (Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 44) lists Discovery Pipeline, 147 miles of 18, 24 and 30 inch, FERC docket CP96-712, cost 176.97 million dollars, completed November 1997. The EIA 147 miles likely includes laterals; 105 miles used here is the sourced main line, well above the 15.5 mile floor. Start year: EIA says 1997, the journal article describes start-up in autumn 1998; 1997 kept from EIA, conflict flagged. Later additions (Keathley Canyon Connector, 20 inch, 209 miles; Market Expansion; Junction Platform) are gathering or separate EIA projects and are not included. Route not found in official GIS; no route staged. EIA and the journal are independent origins but the owner and start-year facts rest on one source each. A discussion of whether the 105 miles is offshore only or total was not resolved.
